decision.verdict: Reject this mechanism-task-model combination as a positive degradation curve. GLM-5 remained flat through ten layers despite large cumulative context.

comparison_to_kimi.kimi_valid_signal: Kimi-K2.6 self-report-only was flat through layer 7 and produced one valid 0/37 tail failure at layer 8.
comparison_to_kimi.glm_signal: GLM-5 stayed flat through layer 10 with no tail failure.
comparison_to_kimi.interpretation: The mechanism is not deterministic across models. Iteration count can expose late tail risk for Kimi, but more iterations alone do not force degradation under the same task and topology.

iteration_hypothesis.evidence: GLM-5 reached ten layers, thirty references, and 11.46x matching-control input load with no degradation.
iteration_hypothesis.remaining_positive_path: A paper claim should be reframed around verifier strength and model-dependent tail risk, or require a valid Kimi/deepseek replication showing post-trigger persistence.
